simple.meaning: בָּצוֹר (bâtsôwr) is a Hebrew action word meaning “inaccessible , i.e. lofty.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Zechariah, beginning at Zechariah 11:2. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בָּצוֹר (H1208) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: בָּצוֹר (bâtsôwr) / H1208 is traced through Zechariah 11:2 with source-language evidence and verse context.
